svg.text: class trump5; pins P0, P1, P2, P3, P4; forced cells BL(0,2), BL(1,1), BR(0,1), TR(0,1), TR(1,0), TL(0,0) (forced_corners.md Theorem FC). Each panel = one multibox node (A171 library, poly obstacles, lonely clip at forced corners, strict_container=False).

Drawing: pins = light-blue squares with the exact core dashed; H = hypothesis square at box centre & mid-tilt (solid) with extremal-tilt outlines (dashed), K' filled, exact axis core dashed, centre pieces thin; roles = window/cell dashed, surviving pieces thin, K' filled when non-empty; red dashed = widened forced boxes (schematic); grey dashed = meeter windows.
547 nodes computed, 45 drawn (base, every corner case, the first alive case's full cascade, every dead node).
